orientation_notes: Center the C-alpha coordinates, align PC1 left-to-right and PC2 vertically, and view along PC3. In this front projection the six-chain assembly has an approximately 300 A horizontal crossbar and a central roughly 80 A downward stem, giving a clear T-like outline. The orthogonal PC1-PC3 edge view is included to show the projection depth and guard against interpreting a single-chain overlap as the shape.
